hero.title: Fair Playtime,
hero.subtitle: The sideline app that tracks playtime, builds fair lineups, and suggests smart substitutions — so every player gets their moment.

features.subtitle: Built for volunteer coaches and parents who just want the game to be fair.

lineup.title: Smart Lineup Builder
lineup.description: Quickly build balanced lineups for any match format — 3v3 all the way to 11v11.

substitutions.title: Smart Substitutions
substitutions.description: Substitution suggestions based on live playtime data, so the rotation is always fair.
